messages:
Maria Chen: FYI vendors/zenith sent invoice INV-2026-0789 for March telecom but there's no PO on the invoice. Vendor claims PO 'Z-3419' was issued - I don't see it in Concur. Can someone help route approval or confirm PO?
Samir Kapur: @Maria Chen can you attach the invoice PDF and vendor email? I can search PO system.
Maria Chen: attaching link -> https://files.redwood/test/invoices/INV-2026-0789.pdf (vendor says PO Z-3419 in email thread). invoice amount $12,340.12.
Finance Bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-2026-0789 (vendor: Zenith Telecom). Workflow: needs PO match or AP exception.
Samir Kapur: Searching POs... nothing matching Z-3419. We have PO-2026-3419 in the old naming scheme? nope. Looks like the vendor used a vendor-side shorthand.
Leo Park: tagging in since this is telecom spend against infra budget. @Priya Nair is the budget owner for platform infra - Priya, do you recall a committed PO for Zenith?
Priya Nair: Not seeing any committed PO for Zenith this month in my queue. Did they provide a WBS or project code? if this is for dedicated colo lines we may have a separate contract reference.
Maria Chen: Vendor email thread: "PO Z-3419 / Contract REF ZT-2024" - attached. No WBS listed.
Samir Kapur: Two options: 1) request vendor to reissue invoice with our official PO (preferred), 2) create internal retro PO and approve on exception if business owner signs off. Which do we want?
Leo Park: If service was consumed and vendor won't reissue quickly we can do exception. I can approve after Priya confirms charge is valid.
Priya Nair: Confirmed this is a recurring line item for colo network; cost center 4402. Approve on exception if AP creates internal PO and marks as "retro-PO - vendor invoice present".
Maria Chen: OK I'll create internal PO. Samir, can you create PO-INT-2026-0897 and tag to cost center 4402? put note: "retro PO for INV-2026-0789 - Zenith Telecom".
Samir Kapur: Will do. creating PO now...
Finance Bot: PO created: PO-INT-2026-0897 (created by Samir Kapur).
Samir Kapur: PO-INT-2026-0897 created and linked to INV-2026-0789. Routing to Leo for approval.
Leo Park: Approved. :thumbsup: I confirm charge is valid and funds exist in 4402.
Finance Bot: Approval recorded: Leo Park approved PO-INT-2026-0897. Routing to AP for payment.
Maria Chen: Great - Priya, do you want me to push vendor to resend with our PO for future invoices?
Priya Nair: Yes please ask them to include full PO number and cost center on future invoices. Also copy contracts to confirm contract ref ZT-2024.
Maria Chen: Sent vendor an email asking for corrected invoice and CC'd contracts.
Samir Kapur: Marking invoice as approved for payment on exception. Payment ETA next AP run (2 business days).
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once vendor confirms reissue. :eyes:
Finance Bot: Thread update: INV-2026-0789 status -> Approved (exception). Payment scheduled.
